statement: Build a one-page website for Brew Lab, a cafe in Indiranagar, Bengaluru, showing the menu, hours, location, a large gallery of the cafe, a story section for each of its three coffee farms, and a pre-order form for pickup.
audience: Local customers in and around Indiranagar, Bengaluru, who want to check the menu and hours, find the cafe, and order coffee and food for pickup, including on a phone.
standards: Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript in one file, no build step; CDN libraries allowed.
Usable at 360px and 1280px widths with no horizontal scrolling.
No JavaScript errors on load or on using the form.
Low running cost: no paid services or subscriptions.
rules: Use only the menu, prices, hours, address, phone, farm facts and WhatsApp number the Requester supplied; do not invent facts.
Pre-orders go to WhatsApp +91 98450 00000 and are paid at pickup.
Pickup is within 15 minutes of ordering.
Gallery images are simple drawings until real photos are supplied.
done_when: The menu section lists exactly: Coffee: Espresso ₹120, Cappuccino ₹180, Pour-over ₹220; Cold: Cold brew ₹200; Food: Croissant ₹150, Banana bread ₹130.
The page shows hours as 8am to 10pm every day, the address 100 Feet Road, Indiranagar, Bengaluru 560038, and the phone +91 80 4000 2468.
The pre-order form lets a visitor pick menu items with quantities, enter a name, and submit; submitting opens a WhatsApp message to +91 98450 00000 containing the chosen items, quantities and name.
The pre-order form area states that payment is at pickup and that pickup is within 15 minutes of ordering.
The gallery section shows 6 drawn images in a large layout, each with alt text.

The farms section has three separate story blocks: Ratnagiri Estate, Chikmagalur (family estate, shade-grown Arabica at 1,400 m, natural-process lots with fruity notes); Kerehaklu, Chikmagalur (fourth-generation farm, replants native forest trees, grows coffee alongside pepper and cardamom); Baarbara Estate, Coorg (small estate, hand-picks only ripe cherries, dries them slowly on raised beds).
The file is one HTML page with sections for menu, hours, location, pre-order, gallery and farms, and every in-page navigation link points to an existing section.
The file loads with no JavaScript errors and has no horizontal overflow at 360px and 1280px widths.
The file uses no paid service, API key or build step.
dropped_from_brief: Real cafe photos: none exist yet, so the gallery uses simple drawings in 6 spots, as the Requester agreed.
Farm stories beyond the supplied facts: the Requester gave one description per farm, so each story is built only from those facts and no extra detail will be invented.
